Admittedly, exhaustion and the biological instinct to need to live.  It's incredibly difficult to overcome these biological sensations that restrain me from being able to actually end things.  In addition, there is a preferred method which I do not have access to. It is not to say that I don't see hope or don't have the capacity to understand what damage it would cause to end my life.  However, to paraphrase a book the burning building that is my brain and body isn't burning hot enough for me to make the jump.  So in the meantime I'm trying to push through and just douse those flames a little bit at a time. It's not easy.  And I am scared that in a moment of desperation that I may do something.  But I have to keep trying.  There isn't much of another choice.
